assets.prompt: Sculpted Chinese 3D animated scene in the wooden flooded lock chamber. Follow the mechanical connections shown by technical diagram image4, translated into actual wooden winch and bronze gear. Camera low side wide shot, south ladder at distant LEFT, closed north door at distant RIGHT. Ma Duo in brown stands at LEFT in shallow ANKLE-deep clear water, aiming his long fork toward Lu Zhao at RIGHT. Lu Zhao stands firmly on the raised dry west repair ledge, hip against a wooden winch frame, old small awl in left hand and right hand at his purse. In foreground left shallow water, a broad OPEN ROPE LOOP lies ahead of Ma Duo feet on his forward path. The SAME ROPE continues from this loop onto the horizontal winch drum, then over a fixed pulley to ONE heavy stone hanging on the right. The stone bottom hangs just 15cm above a sturdy horizontal catch shelf carried by two wooden legs. A triangular WOOD BRAKE WEDGE projects from beneath the drum at Lu Zhao side. An independent bronze ratchet pawl touches the outer teeth of a toothed wheel. A separate FIXED TIMBER BEAM stands between the incoming fork path and the drum, with a clear handspan gap from the rotating drum. Show all of loop, drum, hanging stone, catch shelf and wedge together clearly. Lu Zhao and Ma Duo occupy opposite sides, Ma LEFT and Lu RIGHT. Keep each character face/clothes from their portraits. Clear concrete 3D scene, blank surfaces.
